units.source_text: 明天，也许大火会从天而降，把细长的柱子、优雅的房顶的曲线化为灰烬，我们再也看不见它了。

en.t: Tomorrow, perhaps a great fire will fall from the sky, reduce the slender pillars and the graceful curves of the roof to ashes, and we will never see it again.

units.source_text: 然而，眼前的它那典雅纤细的身影，依然沐浴着夏日火一般灼热的阳光，显得自在自若。

en.t: Yet the elegant, delicate figure before our eyes still bathed in the blazing, firelike summer sunlight, appearing calm and composed.
